parts.name: Root
parts.description: A native button element with pending semantics and interaction-state data attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Content. Receives the live render state (hovered, pressed, focused, pending…) when used as a one-argument snippet.

props.name: pending
props.description: Keeps the button focusable while blocking activation, and announces the pending state politely.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Overrides the internally tracked pressed state.

dataAttributes.name: data-button-live-region
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the internal polite live region used for pending announcements.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the element has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-pending
dataAttributes.description: Present while the button is pending: focusable but blocked from activation.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the button is actively pressed via pointer or keyboard.
